description: This Java source file defines a WearableListenerService that handles incoming messages from a connected Wear device. It processes messages related to clearing notifications, opening an attraction detail screen, and starting navigation to a specific attraction.

classes.name: ListenerService
classes.description: A service extending WearableListenerService to handle messages from a Wear device, processing commands to clear notifications, open attraction details, or start navigation.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming MessageEvent objects, performs actions based on the message path such as clearing notifications, opening detailed attraction views, or starting navigation.
